title: RESULT_PACKET
description: Fixed output contract for one unit of seat work. Two things this shape is built around. First, "not sourced" is a first-class valid result: a packet whose every sourced field reads "not sourced" is well-formed, and returning it is not a failure. Second, absence is never a pass — there is no PASS label in this contract, and a claim can only be PROVEN when it names evidence that a reviewer can open or re-run. No required field forces a company fact to exist. This file is self-contained: no external $ref, so it can be checked without a resolver or a network fetch. Writer is the docs leftover; COO is first QC and the PA last-gates. Candidate-visible.

outcome.description: How the run came out. not_sourced is a valid outcome and is not scored as a failure — it says the run looked and the source was not there. There is deliberately no PASS value here, because nothing about an absence is a pass.

deliverables.description: One entry per deliverable the packet asked for, whether or not it was produced. A deliverable that was not produced is reported as not produced with a reason, never omitted.

claims.description: Every statement this result makes, each carrying exactly one classification label and its evidence. An empty array is valid: a run that makes no claim asserts nothing.

sourced_fields.description: One entry per field the workflow was meant to fill. Each is either sourced, with a source_id, or "not sourced". A field is never dropped to avoid saying it was not sourced.

named_missing.description: Gaps this run touched that stay named missing. Nothing here is filled in by the run; an empty array means the run touched none.

unresolved.description: What is still open at the end of the run. Carried into a HANDOFF_PACKET if the run is handed off.

send_performed.description: Nothing goes to a client, a prospect, or the public without Michael. A result packet cannot report a send, so the only valid value is false.

kpi_current.description: KPI Current stays empty. Empty is not 0, so this array carries no current value of any kind, including 0.

holder_named.description: A holder named by this result. COO — Anthony C. Garcia — is the only holder recorded anywhere; every other seat reads null, which means not recorded.

classification.description: Exactly one label per claim. PROVEN means a reviewer can open the path or re-run the record. SELF-REPORTED means somebody said so. UNVERIFIED means nobody checked. FAILED means it was checked and did not hold. There is no PASS.

kind.description: What the evidence is. "not sourced" is an honest kind, and it is the one kind that can never support a PROVEN claim.

detail.description: The path, the command record, or the report. When kind is "not sourced", the detail is the literal string "not sourced".

allOf.$comment: Absence is never a pass: a claim with no evidence cannot be PROVEN or SELF-REPORTED.
PROVEN needs something a reviewer can open or re-run. A report that somebody said so is not it.

value.description: The sourced value, or the literal string "not sourced".

allOf.$comment: An unsourced field says so in its own value, and cannot carry a source it does not have.
A sourced field names its source and does not read "not sourced".

location.description: Where the produced deliverable is. Required when produced is true.

reason.description: Why it was not produced. Required when produced is false, so nothing goes missing without a stated reason.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date, or date and time. Structural only — it carries no company fact.

role_slug.description: The 46 seat slugs, one per seat page.
